title: Round tax totals at invoice level
author: gharrow

userContentEdits.diff:
Tax was rounded per line item and then summed, so multi-line invoices
could disagree with the tax authority's invoice-level calculation by a
cent or two. This sums unrounded line tax and rounds once at the invoice
level, with a backfill migration recomputing stored totals.

reviews.author: sgetta
reviews.body: Approving the rename and the invoice-level approach; assuming the credit-note handling lands before merge.

comments.author: sgetta
comments.body: `computeTaxV2` says nothing about what changed; name it for what it does.

comments.author: sgetta
comments.body: `round_half_up` adds 0.5 and floors, which truncates toward zero for negatives: a credit note of -10.005 rounds to -10.00, but accounting expects -10.01 (half away from zero). Every credit note with a half-cent tax total will be off by a cent, and the backfill migration applies this to stored credit notes too.

comments.author: gharrow
comments.body: Good point — I'll handle credit notes.
